title: dahlia variabilis
intro: Dahlia variabilis, commonly known as the showy dahlia or pompon dahlia, is a species of flowering plant in the dahlia family. This plant is used in herbal medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dahlia variabilis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's bioactive compounds may also contribute to its wound-healing, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine.
